gizmo.title: Isidlali samadokhumenti
gizmo.description: Umhlahlandlela, isibonakaliso nereferensi yengxenye yewebhu, nezinkinobho zokukopisha ze-HTML, import, npm ne-CDN.

configure.title: Ibhodi lendaba lomhlahlandlela
configure.description: Ibhodi lendaba lokunyakaza eliza nesakhi (tag.motion.json). Kuyakhethwa.

configure.title: Isifundo sevidiyo
configure.description: Ividiyo emfushane mayelana nesakhi (YouTube, Vimeo noma ifayela levidiyo). Ithatha indawo yevidiyo esedatheni yamadokhumenti.

configure.title: Umhlahlandlela odlala ngokuzenzakalelayo
configure.description: Qala umhlahlandlela ngokushesha uma isidlali sivela. Akunakwa uma umfundi ekhetha ukunyakaza okuncane.

advanced.title: Isihloko somhlahlandlela
advanced.description: Ezakhini ezinemihlahlandlela eminingana, isihloko okufanele sivulwe kuqala (isibonelo add-blocks). Shiya kungenalutho kowomqoka.

advanced.title: Isixhumanisi sesibonakaliso esibukhoma
advanced.description: Lapho inkinobho ethi Vula umthombo wesibonakaliso iya khona. Okuzenzakalelayo yifolda ye-demo ku-repository.

advanced.title: Isixhumanisi samadokhumenti
advanced.description: Lapho inkinobho yamadokhumenti agcwele iya khona, isibonelo ikhasi le-Learn HAX elifanayo.
